title: SOMevidence 1.0.0
text: Added explicit data, preprocessing, resampling, SOM specification objects. Added leakage-safe transformations layer normalization estimated within analysis split. Added row-, group-, block-, leave-domain-, custom resampling designs.

title: SOMevidence 1.0.0
text: Added reproducible single- multi-layer SOM ensembles across map grids, random seeds, resamples. Added quantization error, topographic error, empty-unit rate, structured model-warning failure records. Added candidate-partition stability, ARI, AMI, clusterwise Jaccard, membership support, assignment entropy, scalable consensus analyses. Added explicit defensibility gates without composite score, universal threshold, forced class naming, automatic selection number classes.

title: SOMevidence 1.0.0
text: Added controlled K-means, Ward.D2, Gaussian mixture-model comparisons using common splits preprocessing. Added held-domain new-data mapping diagnostics based training-derived preprocessing. Added prespecified sensitivity workflows cross-scenario comparisons. Added post hoc external-label assessment reports agreement rather classification accuracy.

title: SOMevidence 1.0.0
text: Added editable component, occupancy, neighbour-distance, stability, consensus, cross-model, transfer, sensitivity plots. Added optional Shiny interface reproducible R-script YAML export.
